title: Agentic Returns Gateway impact model: fit-related returns, ALDO_CA

headline_numbers.label: Size-related return lines (Too small + Too big)
headline_numbers.basis: 21.48% of 61,998 completed ALDO_CA return lines, 2025-02-01 to 2026-01-31. Lines, not customers.

headline_numbers.label: Annual net value, post-purchase exchange (base case)
headline_numbers.basis: Range CAD 40,912.80 (low) to CAD 193,525.62 (high). Rests on assumed 10/20/30% exchange conversion and a placeholder agent cost (pending_measurement).

headline_numbers.label: Pre-purchase prevention what-if (base case)
headline_numbers.basis: 5% of the measured size-related lines prevented. Range CAD 0.00 (0%) to CAD 101,209.20 (10%). Pilot hypothesis, separate lever, not additive.

key_assumptions: Exchange conversion of size-related lines 10/20/30% and prevention before purchase 0/5/10% (low/base/high, assumed). Both are assumptions to validate in a pilot.
Value per converted or retained case CAD 54.00 and avoided return cost CAD 22.00 (assumed, synthetic unit economics from handoff section 15).
Agent cost per run CAD 0.5000 is a placeholder (pending_measurement) until the live eval.
Fit lines are return lines, not customers.

tag_legend.measured: Counted or summed directly from the provided CSV files.
tag_legend.derived: Calculated from measured numbers and/or assumptions with the formula shown.
tag_legend.assumed: An input chosen by the team, or a what-if result built only from such inputs and a measured baseline. It is not observed in ALDO data and must be validated in a pilot.
tag_legend.pending_measurement: Placeholder until the live eval measures it (docs/eval/results.json).

agent_cost_note: Agent cost per run is a deliberately conservative placeholder of CAD 0.5000, tagged pending_measurement (file not found: `docs/eval/results.json`). It is not a measurement. Run the live eval, then re-run `python3.12 scripts/build_impact_model.py` so the cost becomes derived from measured tokens. The agent cost and annual net value are provisional until then.

filter.text: store_banner = 'ALDO_CA' AND last return status = 'RETURN_COMPLETED' AND return_creation_date in 2025-02-01..2026-01-31; fit line = reason equals 'too small' or 'too big' after strip, lower-case, whitespace collapse and removal of the 'return.page.reasons.' prefix

total_return_lines.label: Return lines in scope
total_return_lines.note: One line is one CSV row. The source has duplicate (order, SKU) groups, so a line is not guaranteed to be an independent return unit.

fit_share_of_lines.label: Fit lines as share of all lines in scope

fit_refund_sum.label: Refund amount of fit lines, sum
fit_refund_sum.note: Column summed as provided. Context for the funnel, not an input to the annual-value formula and not a realized loss. Line versus transaction grain is unconfirmed.

fit_refund_median.label: Refund amount of fit lines, median

distinct_return_numbers_in_scope.label: Distinct return numbers in scope
distinct_return_numbers_in_scope.note: Several lines can share one return number.

distinct_return_numbers_fit.label: Distinct return numbers with a fit line

days_with_lines.label: Days with at least one line

lines_per_day_mean.label: Lines per day, mean
lines_per_day_mean.note: Mean over all calendar days in the window (days without lines count as 0).

lines_per_day_p95.label: Lines per day, p95
lines_per_day_p95.note: 95th percentile of the daily counts, linear interpolation between closest ranks.

confirmed_all_stores.label: CONFIRMED in-store exchanges, all stores in file
confirmed_all_stores.note: Replacement sale recorded inside the return transaction.

assumed_all_stores.label: ASSUMED in-store exchanges, all stores in file
assumed_all_stores.note: Inferred when a separate in-store sale followed within five minutes. Never merge with CONFIRMED.

confirmed_aldo_ca_stores.label: CONFIRMED in-store exchanges, stores attributed to ALDO_CA
confirmed_aldo_ca_stores.note: The exchange file has no banner column and covers several banners. Attribution maps Return store to the banner seen for the same in-store return location in the returns file.

assumed_aldo_ca_stores.label: ASSUMED in-store exchanges, stores attributed to ALDO_CA

rows_other_banners.label: Exchange rows in stores attributed to other banners

rows_unmapped_store.label: Exchange rows whose store could not be attributed to a banner

units_in_window.label: Exchanged units (sum of Exchange QTY) in window

formula:
annual_net_value = fit_lines x exchange_conversion x value_per_converted_case
                 + fit_lines x exchange_conversion x repeat_return_reduction x avoided_second_return_cost
                 - total_requests x agent_cost_per_run

exchange_conversion_pct.label: Exchange conversion of fit-reason lines
exchange_conversion_pct.note: Share of fit-reason lines that become exchanges. Assumption to validate in a pilot.

repeat_return_reduction_pct.label: Repeat-return reduction on converted cases
repeat_return_reduction_pct.note: Share of converted cases where a second return is avoided thanks to the fit insight.

value_per_converted_case.label: Incremental value per converted case
value_per_converted_case.note: Handoff section 15 synthetic unit economics: exchange (-28) minus refund (-82) = +54. Incremental economic value, not gross margin.

avoided_second_return_cost.label: Avoided second-return cost
avoided_second_return_cost.note: Reverse logistics 12 + handling 10 (design section 12, handoff section 15).

total_requests.label: Agent runs charged (total return lines in window)
total_requests.note: Conservative: one run is charged for every return line in scope, not only fit-reason lines.

agent_cost_per_run.label: Agent cost per run
agent_cost_per_run.note: Placeholder until the live eval measures it. Re-run this script after the eval.

converted_cases.label: Converted cases
converted_cases.note: Fit lines x exchange conversion (expected value, rounded for display).

exchange_value.label: Exchange value
exchange_value.note: Converted cases x incremental value per converted case.

agent_cost_total.label: Agent cost (total requests x cost per run)

annual_net_value.label: Annual net value
annual_net_value.note: The 12-month window is used as the annual figure (no scaling).

prevention_what_if.framing: Pilot hypothesis against a measured baseline: sizing guidance before purchase could stop some size-related returns from happening at all. The baseline is measured; the prevention rates and unit values are assumptions to validate in a pilot. This is not a forecast.

baseline_fit_lines.label: Baseline: size-related return lines (Too small + Too big), window
baseline_fit_lines.note: Measured, same window and base as the exchange scenarios.

prevention_rate_pct.label: Share of size-related return lines prevented before purchase
prevention_rate_pct.note: Pilot hypothesis. Not observed in ALDO data.

avoided_return_cost.label: Avoided return cost per prevented case
avoided_return_cost.note: Reverse logistics 12 + handling 10 (design section 12, handoff section 15).

retained_case_value.label: Value per retained case
retained_case_value.note: Handoff section 15 synthetic unit economics (exchange versus refund = +54). Incremental economic value, not gross margin.

prevented_lines.label: Prevented return lines
prevented_lines.note: Baseline x prevention rate (expected value, rounded for display).

avoided_return_cost_value.label: Avoided return cost
avoided_return_cost_value.note: Prevented lines x avoided return cost.

retained_sale_value.label: Retained-sale value
retained_sale_value.note: Prevented lines x value per retained case.

total_value.label: Annual value (what-if)
total_value.note: The 12-month window is used as the annual figure. No sizing-assistant operating cost is subtracted.

prevention_what_if.formula: annual_value = fit_lines x prevention_rate x (avoided_return_cost + value_per_retained_case)

caveats: Fit lines are return lines, not customers. A customer can appear on several lines and some rows have no customer identifier (see the data profile), so customers cannot be counted from this file.
Exchange conversion rates (10, 20 and 30 percent) are assumptions to validate in a pilot. The share of fit-reason lines is not a conversion rate and must not be used as one.
CAD assumed for ALDO_CA, unconfirmed: the source files have no currency column.

Value per converted case (CAD 54) comes from the synthetic unit economics in handoff section 15 (CAD 100 order, cost 40, refund path -82 versus exchange path -28). It is incremental economic value, not accounting gross profit and not ALDO-measured.
Refund amounts are summed as provided. Whether the column is line or transaction grain is unconfirmed, so the sum is context for the funnel only and is not a realized loss or a revenue figure.
Total requests is set to the number of return lines in scope (one agent run per line). This is conservative because one return can have several lines and the agent would not run on every line.

The exchange file has no banner column. Store attribution to ALDO_CA is inferred from the returns file and is tagged derived. No exchange rate is computed: only about 26 percent of exchange rows match an original order (handoff section 5), so dividing by returns would be misleading.

CONFIRMED means the replacement sale is inside the return transaction. ASSUMED is inferred from a separate in-store sale within five minutes. The two are reported separately and no causal effect is claimed.
The window covers 12 months, so window totals are used as annual values without seasonality scaling.

Pre-purchase prevention is a pilot hypothesis, not a forecast. The baseline (size-related return lines) is measured; the prevention rates (0, 5, 10 percent) and both unit values are assumptions to validate in a pilot, so every what-if result is tagged assumed.
The prevention what-if is a separate lever and is not additive with the exchange-conversion scenarios: a prevented return cannot also be converted to an exchange. Do not add the two tables together.

Per prevented case the what-if adds the avoided return cost (CAD 22) and the retained-sale value (CAD 54). Both come from the synthetic unit economics, and part of the CAD 54 may already include return handling cost, so the sum may overstate. No sizing-assistant operating cost is subtracted.
The prevention baseline counts size-related lines from every return channel in the returns file. The share that pre-purchase guidance could reach is not measured.
